audit.summary: The p6 task-vector sign inference is invalid; numerical narratives overstate uniform preservation and the stopping rule conflicts. These are local demonstrated problems. The empirical six-task robustness advantage is not refuted. Scalar guarantees, historical implementation, units and broader/adaptive robustness need evidence.
